create.name: Natalie Southgate
create.bio:
Natalie Southgate is the Australian creator of Chakradance, a practice of free, eyes-closed dancing to music composed for each of the seven chakras. Born in Sydney, she grew up dancing, then trained as an energy healer and studied Jungian psychology in London, where she ran the first Chakradance class in 1998 with ten people in the room. After a long stay in India she returned to Australia in 2001 and spent years refining the format and its music, which she now makes with the composer Dale Nougher. She has led sessions at a Deepak Chopra seminar in California and set out the method in a book for Hay House.

A typical Chakradance session opens with a guided meditation, moves through the chakras one at a time with imagery and improvised movement, and closes by drawing a mandala to hold what came up. No dance training is needed and there are no steps to learn. From her home in Noosa, Queensland, she runs home-study programmes such as the daily Home Practice and Mantra Dance, posts short talks on intuition, energy and self-trust on YouTube, and trains the facilitators who now teach the method in many countries, with an in-person certification held in Noosa.

books.title: Chakradance: Move Your Chakras, Change Your Life
books.author: Natalie Southgate
books.description: Her Hay House book on the chakras as gateways between body, mind and spirit, and on how dancing to music made for each one can loosen what feels stuck. It comes with links to short practice tracks and moving meditations.

courses.title: Chakradance Home Practice
courses.description: A self-paced daily programme pairing about fifteen minutes of free dance with a few minutes of meditation. Each stage focuses on one chakra, with short teachings on its themes alongside the music.

courses.title: Chakradance Mantra Dance
courses.description: Seven sessions, one for each chakra, in which you chant that chakra's seed sound and then dance it. Each includes a guided meditation and a mandala drawing to finish.

courses.title: Chakradance 7 Keys to Freedom Home Video Workshop
courses.description: A recorded workshop to do at home on noticing and loosening old habits of mind. It runs from an opening meditation through all seven chakras in movement and ends with mandala art.

courses.title: Chakradance Chakra Activations
courses.description: Seven guided audio meditations of around fifteen minutes, one per chakra, set to music composed for each centre. Comes with a short video on how to use them and a PDF of notes for every chakra.

courses.title: Chakradance Noosa 2027 Facilitator Certification (Cert 1 & 2)
courses.description: A six-day live training with Natalie in Noosa, Queensland, for people who want to lead Chakradance classes. It covers running the practice with groups and setting up as a facilitator.
courses.price: $5,497 USD (pay in full; instalment plans and a Cert 1 only option are listed)

free_resources.title: The Chakra Awakening
free_resources.description: A free fifteen-minute guided audio journey up through all seven chakras, with music, nature sounds and singing bowls. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: The 15-Minute Chakradance Experience
free_resources.description: A short free taster of the dance itself, with Natalie guiding you through the chakras in movement. Sent by email after sign-up.

free_resources.title: Chakradance Daily Ritual
free_resources.description: A free fifteen-minute track from the Freedom practice, meant to be danced as a regular daily routine. Sent by email after sign-up.
